notes.title: 1.08 patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the Skull Head boss could get stuck and become unable to move.

notes.title: 1.07 update
notes.content:
Added functionality to change keyboard and mouse key bindings in settings.
 The mouse is now confined within the game window to prevent accidental clicks for muti-screen players.
 Removed the halving effect on titanium income in simple mode.
 Titanium income when falling changed from halved to -20%.
 Added a confirmation UI for retreating and restarting.
 Updated the sound effect for picking up crystals.

notes.title: 1.06 update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the achievement for unlocking all levels.
 Removed saving Debug files at the end of each level.
 Challenge mode unlocks after clearing a level once.
 Fixed a bug with sea surface reflections.

notes.title: Pre-Festival Update
notes.content:
June 8th - Pre-Festival Update

Added Easy Mode: In Easy Mode, you can revive by consuming a small amount of Titanium!

New level selection interface in the lobby.

Added new enemy aircraft.

Updated enemies guarding the deep sea.

Did you know? Almost all enemy bullets can be canceled out by the player's attacks.

notes.title: Demo update: Leaderboard!
notes.content:
Now have the Steam leaderboard! 
Fixed the shop item refresh bug.

notes.title: 0147 Update, Newbie Tutorial
notes.content:
Updated the brand new interactive novice tutorial! 
Fixed the bug of shop item refreshing.
